raw_transcription:
Look around, see the sky, feel the love keeping your arm.
There's a light that never dies, one truth sets us apart.
In the world full of noise, hear the whisper in the air.
God ain't lost through the choice, one love always stand.
Only one God above shining bright with endless love.
Feel the faith in every soul, one God makes us whole.
Feel the storm in the rain, find a peace in us embrace.
In the joy and the pain, one God in every place, when you feel lost and alone.
Just look up and you will see in the stars, in the pain.
One God in every place, when you feel lost and alone.
Just look up and you will see in the stars, in the dawn.
One God says you're free, only one God above shining bright with endless love.
Feel the faith in every soul, one God makes us whole.
formatted_lyrics:
[Verse]
Look around see the sky
Feel the love deep in your heart
There's a light that never dies
One truth sets us apart

[Verse 2]
In the world full of noise
Hear the whisper in the air
Guiding us through the choice
One love always there

[Chorus]
Only one God above
Shining bright with endless love
Feel the faith in every soul
One God makes us whole

[Verse]
Through the storm and the rain
Find the peace in His embrace
In the joy in the pain
One God in every place

[Bridge]
When you feel lost and alone
Just look up and you will see
In the stars in the dawn
One God sets you free

[Chorus]
Only one God above
Shining bright with endless love
Feel the faith in every soul
One God makes us whole
